implementationDecisions: Project-local compiler/clean header overlay; no system file or driver changes.
Four compile jobs for31GiBhost RAM; build time may be longer than more parallel jobs.
KTX2 rejected pending full validation; users must convert to PNG/JPEG.
Static preview asset for this animation-free model; original skinned files preserved.
Performance claims use actual NR-on measurements on the prepared test asset; GPU network time and whole-frame time are reported separately.

Render and NR resolution always follow actual window client size; CLI dimensions only request initial window size. Identical sizes preserve GPU resources; minimized windows suspend rendering and reset temporal history on restoration.
Background color picker uses accurate sRGB-to-linear conversion and a solid skybox, preserves IBL and resets NR history. Scene defaults to4x MSAA; explicit scene/UI values remain supported.
Filament transmission/volume templates require the matching glTF extension, so ordinary specular/IOR PBR and alpha hair retain normal render-pass ordering.
Four manifest-driven Poly Haven HDR presets load outside active frames, retain IBL intensity/rotation, reset NR history on success and preserve the prior environment on failure.
Scripted captures use fixed60Hz animation time, record actual NR state, frame40 raw linear scene and camera text for matched-input comparisons; normal rendering retains wall-clock time.
